title: Generative Transfer for Entropic Optimal Transport with Unknown Costs
summary: This paper addresses the practical challenge in Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) where the underlying ground cost function is typically latent and unobserved. Rather than assuming a fixed geometric cost, we adopt a data-driven approach where a shared cost is revealed only through samples from a reference optimal coupling. The question is then: given samples from a reference optimal coupling, can we recover the optimal coupling for new marginals under the same latent cost?
